<div class="card-body">
'''Blizzard 2''' is a [[Dark]] [[Vehicle]] ([[Combat Vehicle]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊ブリザード２</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">１名のパイロットと８名の乗客を搭乗させられる。対：損耗＜４。能力値２の専属パイロットが搭乗している。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Blizzard-2-PSA-147361094.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">裏切り者のネヴァー将軍が暗殺されるまで指揮していたＡＴ－ＡＴ。偏執狂的なこの将軍が、追加の装甲を施していた。密閉型。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Blizzard 2.

'''Card text:'''
May add 1 pilot and 8 passengers. Immune to attrition < 4. A permanent pilot providing ability of 2 is aboard.

'''Lore:'''
An AT-AT commanded by the treacherous General Nevar until he was assassinated. The paranoid general had extra armor added. Enclosed.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Blizzard 2]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
